description: 40 manually authored single-chunk documents, eight fixed queries; six English and two Chinese queries. Relevant sets are declared before measurement; each has five relevant documents.
documents: seekdb hybrid retrieval combines dense vector similarity with full-text keyword matching inside one database query.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion combines positions from semantic and lexical retrieval. The database computes the final ranked list.
BM25 full-text search helps retrieve exact product names and identifiers that semantic vectors may miss.
A hybrid query runs cosine HNSW retrieval alongside a full-text index, then returns the database's fused Top K.
混合检索同时利用向量语义与全文关键词匹配，RRF 融合与排序在 seekdb 数据库内部执行。
After adding document vectors, refresh the seekdb index before publishing the document as searchable.
Incremental indexing adds new knowledge without rebuilding every existing document vector.
A document in importing or failed state is excluded from both retrieval paths until index refresh succeeds.
HNSW indexes approximate nearest neighbors. Refreshing their incremental data makes newly inserted vectors visible.
新增文档写入后刷新索引，再标记为可检索；导入中断的文档不会参与召回。
Transformers.js performs text embedding in a browser Worker. Document content is never sent to a cloud inference service.
The Node backend stores supplied embeddings and runs database queries; it never invokes the embedding model.
Local browser inference keeps expensive model computation outside the UI thread and needs no inference API key.
Download open ONNX weights once and cache them in the browser; subsequent local inference reuses those weights.
浏览器 Worker 本地生成文档与查询向量，不调用云端推理 API，Node 后端不生成 Embedding。
WebGPU availability requires a working adapter and a successful model execution, not merely navigator.gpu.
If WebGPU model initialization fails, recreate the Worker and run the same INT8 model with the WASM CPU backend.
A real warmup inference checks GPU operator compatibility before the page reports that the model is ready.
The page displays the actual successful inference backend and preserves the reason for a WebGPU fallback.
WebGPU 失败后重新创建 Worker，再使用 WASM；页面显示实际后端和降级原因。
TXT and Markdown imports must use UTF-8 encoding. Original text, line endings, and byte order marks are preserved.
Split text into short overlapping chunks, favoring sentence or paragraph boundaries instead of splitting Unicode surrogate pairs.
Every chunk stores its document ID, chunk number, and UTF-16 start and end offsets into the original document.
Each imported file is limited to one MiB and 512 chunks. The browser embeds chunks in small batches.
文档按句子边界切分并保留重叠，每个分块记录原文偏移，检索结果可以回读完整原文。
Each knowledge base has an independent seekdb collection. A database metadata filter also checks the knowledge base ID.
Both full-text and vector search apply the same allowed document IDs so incomplete uploads remain hidden.
Switching knowledge bases clears existing results and discards delayed responses from the previous knowledge base.
Serialize operations on one SDK session so concurrent requests cannot overwrite the hybrid search parameter variable.
知识库使用独立 Collection，切换后丢弃旧请求响应，避免不同知识库的文档和结果相互混入。
The all-MiniLM-L6-v2 sentence encoder produces 384-dimensional embeddings with mean pooling and L2 normalization.
INT8 post-training quantization reduces model weight storage while preserving the model architecture and embedding dimension.
Compare full precision FP32 and quantized INT8 weights on the same fixed queries and relevance labels to measure Recall at five.
Quantized model weights do not imply quantized output vectors: the browser still returns normalized floating point embeddings.
同一个 MiniLM 模型对比 FP32 与 INT8，固定语料和查询不变，统计体积压缩与 Recall@5 变化。
Docker Compose runs the local seekdb service on port 2881 and persists its database directory across container restarts.
The Node server exposes the API and Vite development frontend on port 5173; the production build is served on port 3001.
Measure model loading, chunk throughput, write and refresh time, query embedding, database search, and end-to-end latency separately.
Repeat fixed benchmark groups three times and report medians. Distinguish the first uncached model load from later cached loads.
性能测试使用固定数据多次运行取中位数，区分首次加载、缓存加载和预热后查询。

queries.text: How are semantic matches and exact keywords ranked together?
How can freshly uploaded material become searchable without rebuilding everything?
Where is text encoded when no hosted inference endpoint is allowed?
What happens when graphics acceleration cannot execute the encoder?
How can an imported text passage be traced back to its original file?
How are delayed search responses kept out of a different knowledge base?
模型量化后维度和输出向量格式会改变吗，如何对比检索质量？
如何复现本地部署，并区分冷启动和预热后的各项性能？
